title: Zero price enables free minting
severity_rationale: Downgraded from M-03. Owner-only function (setPrice/registerDispatcher). Admin misconfiguration per C4 rules. No external attack vector.
description: No minimum price validation. Zero is absorbing state: 0 + (0*bps)/10000 = 0
impact: Free unlimited NFT minting dilutes all existing holders
recommendation: Add require(newPrice > 0) in setPrice() and registerDispatcher()
root_cause: No minimum price validation, zero as absorbing state
